text:
cassie: Quick sync on the pricing docs PR: I'm proposing we use the term 'slab' for incremental metering buckets and add an explicit worked example + SDK header snippets. Pushed a tiny WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1599 (preview incoming).

jules: I'm good with 'slab' as long as we add a short glossary line. Don't rename backend fields.

cassie: Yep glossary line: 'Slab = incremental usage bucket used to compute marginal per-unit price.' Will add.

priya: Billing team ok with the wording. Please include a clear worked example with numbers customers can eyeball. Also note rounding (we bill to the cent daily).

cassie: Draft worked example:
  - slab A: 000k tokens @ $0.0008
  - slab B: 100k1M @ $0.0006
  - slab C: >1M @ $0.00045
  Example cost for 1,000,000 tokens = 100k*$0.0008 + 900k*$0.0006 = $0.68

ben: For the SDK section, include both curl (headers) and JS (v2 metadata) snippets. Keep snippets minimal.

jules: Runtime headers we should document: currently runtime returns X-Quota-Remaining and X-Rate-Slab. Do not invent X-Billing-Rate unless runtime adds it. @tom?

tom: Correct. We expose X-Quota-Remaining and X-Rate-Slab today. We can add X-Billing-Rate but it's a small API change and needs rollout. Docs should show the stable headers and a short 'mapping' table.

cassie: Will add mapping table: header -> plain meaning -> UI use. Also callout about eventual consistency (quota counters can lag ~30s).

ben: Snippets to include:
  ```
  # curl: get headers from completions endpoint
  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -d '{"model":"rwd/llama-3-small","input":"hello"}'
  # Look for: X-Quota-Remaining, X-Rate-Slab
  ```
  and
  ```js
  // JS SDK v2: headers available on res.metadata
  const res = await client.completions.create({model: 'rwd/llama-3-small', input: 'hi'});
  console.log(res.metadata['x-quota-remaining']);
  console.log(res.metadata['x-rate-slab']);
  ```

cassie: Also add migration note: v1 SDK users read raw HTTP headers; v2 surfaces them on response.metadata. Link to SDK migration guide.

jules: Small UX ask: rename dashboard panel from 'Quota overview' to 'Billing by slab' so customers find it. Docs should mention redirect behavior.

tom: I can rename the Grafana panel. We'll keep old permalink working for 90 days and add redirect. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=slab. I'll file the change and confirm when done.

laura: If dashboard link changes, include a short migration note in docs and the new permalink in the PR preview. I'll test links when the preview is up.

cassie: I'll include the preview URL when deploy finishes. deploy-bot should post it. Also adding a recommended alert snippet: trigger when 1h rolling cost delta > $50.

priya: Add embeddings worked example too (same slabs, show per-embedding-unit calc; assume 1 embedding = 512 units for calc).

cassie: Will append a tiny embeddings calc so page stays compact.

ben: One more SDK nit: show how to surface slab info in a small UI badge (JS example with mapping table).

cassie: Added a short mapping + UI badge snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview-1599 started 1 build queued. Preview will be available shortly: https://deploy-preview-1599--docs.redwood.ai/rate-slabing

laura: Thanks 1 will review tomorrow and confirm dashboard rename works with redirect.

cassie: I'll tag reviewers (laura, jules) and tom for the Grafana rename in the PR. Checklist in description: glossary, worked examples, header mapping, curl+JS snippets, dashboard name + redirect note, alert rule example, rounding/legal note.

jules: LGTM for doc structure. Quick ask: can the pricing table show monospace token counts and an inline formula? e.g., 'Cost = 100k * $0.0008 + 900k * $0.0006'.

cassie: Done. I'll update PR tonight and ping when ready for final review.

priya: Thanks all.
